reader.kosync.learn_more_description:
Kobo-managed books use Kobo’s built-in sync, even when the file has no DRM. ROREADER leaves their progress syncing to Kobo.

KOsync is a separate service for KOReader and ROREADER. To use it for this title, add a DRM-free copy to your device as a separate sideloaded book and open that copy.

Use the same book file on every device. Only reading progress is synced; books, bookmarks and annotations are not transferred.
